chapter.heading: A Song of degrees.
chapter.v:
They that
trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.

As the
mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

For the
rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

Do good,
O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.

As for
such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
